description:
Use the global TikTok 47.0.3 APK with Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Keep your existing signing key when updating.

## Changes

* **TikTok:** Remove feed ads now catches location-affiliate videos marked "Creator earns commission," including posts with empty shopping and standard ad fields. It reads TikTok's native disclosure model before the feed receives the video. Ordinary location tags aren't enough to block a post.
* **TikTok:** Remove feed ads also catches paid partnerships and branded content. The separate paid-partnership control remains available, and related switches are grouped under Ads.
* **TikTok:** Keeping only For You hides its redundant top title and underline. Search stays available.
* **TikTok:** Hide floating promotions gains an optional control for the purple rewards shortcut on Profile. It's off by default.

## Verification

1,486 runtime tests and 247 patch tests passed, along with both Android lint checks. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with no unexpected manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks; 47.0.3 remains the supported install target.

The final bundle was used for a same-key S22 replacement install. The installed APK matches the tested candidate byte for byte. Both reported commission examples are removed by the actual ad-filter boundary and patched native feed getter with filtering on, and remain with it off. An ordinary-video control stays available. Settings were restored, and fresh feed checks passed. This doesn't claim every server-delivered disclosure variant has been encountered.

The exact new build wasn't installed on the secondary S25 because its existing signing key differs. No app data was removed. The downloadable file is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.
